verses.text: The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, turn your face toward Jerusalem. Preach against its holy places and prophesy against the land of Israel.
Tell the land of Israel, 'This is what the LORD says: Look, I am against you. I will pull my sword out of its sheath and cut off from you both the righteous and the wicked.
Because I am going to cut off both the righteous and the wicked, my sword will come out of its sheath against everyone from south to north.
Then everyone will know that I, the LORD, have pulled my sword out of its sheath. It will not go back again.'
So groan, son of man! Groan in front of them with a broken heart and bitter grief.

When they ask you, 'Why are you groaning?' tell them, 'Because of the news that is coming. Every heart will melt with fear, and every hand will hang limp. Every spirit will faint, and every knee will be as weak as water. Look, it is coming! It will surely happen, says the Lord GOD.'"
The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, prophesy and say, 'This is what the LORD says: A sword, a sword, sharpened and polished!
It is sharpened for slaughter and polished to flash like lightning. Should we celebrate? My son's royal scepter looks down on every tree, but the sword will strike it.
The sword is handed over to be polished and held in the hand. It is sharpened and polished, ready for the hand of the killer.'
Cry out and wail, son of man, because the sword is against my people. It is against all the leaders of Israel. They are thrown to the sword along with my people. So beat your chest in grief.
Testing will surely come. And what if the scepter, which looks down on the sword, is no more?" says the Lord GOD.
"So, son of man, prophesy and clap your hands. Let the sword strike twice, even three times. It is a sword for slaughter, a sword for great slaughter, closing in on them from every side.
I have stationed the sword for slaughter at all their gates, so that hearts will melt with fear and many will fall. Oh! It is made to flash like lightning. It is drawn for slaughter.
Slash to the right, then to the left, wherever your blade is turned.
I too will clap my hands, and my fury will calm down. I, the LORD, have spoken."
The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to take. Both will start from the same country. Put up a signpost where the road branches off to the city.
Mark one road for the sword to come against Rabbah of the Ammonites, and the other against Judah and fortified Jerusalem.
For the king of Babylon stands at the fork in the road, where the two roads split, to look for a sign. He shakes the arrows, asks advice from his household idols, and examines the liver of an animal.

The sign in his right hand points to Jerusalem. There he will set up battering rams, give the order to slaughter, and sound the battle cry. He will set battering rams against the gates, build a siege ramp, and set up siege walls.
To the people of Jerusalem, who have sworn oaths of loyalty, it will seem like a false sign. But he will remind them of their guilt and capture them.
So this is what the Lord GOD says: 'Because you have reminded me of your guilt by rebelling openly, so that your sins show in everything you do, and because you have done this, you will be captured.
And you, wicked prince of Israel, about to be killed, your day has come, the time of your final punishment.
This is what the Lord GOD says: Take off the turban and remove the crown! Things will not stay as they are. Raise up the lowly and bring down the proud.
A ruin, a ruin, I will make it a ruin! The crown will not be restored until the one comes who has the right to it. To him I will give it.'

And you, son of man, prophesy and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says about the Ammonites and their insults: A sword, a sword is drawn for slaughter! It is polished to destroy and to flash like lightning.

Your prophets see false visions for you and tell you lying predictions. But the sword will fall on the necks of the wicked who are to be killed, whose day has come, the time of their final punishment.
Put the sword back in its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your birth, I will judge you.
I will pour out my anger on you and blow on you with the fire of my fury. I will hand you over to cruel men, skilled at destruction.
You will be fuel for the fire. Your blood will be spilled in your land, and you will no longer be remembered. For I, the LORD, have spoken.'"
